# Deployment

## Environments

Git is distributed as a compiled binary. There are no named cloud environments
(dev/staging/prod) — instead there are **build configurations**:

| Configuration | How |
|---------------|-----|
| Developer build | `make` (with `DEVELOPER=1` for extra warnings) |
| Release build | `make` with platform-specific flags from `config.mak.uname` |
| Optimised build | `make CFLAGS="-O2 -DNDEBUG"` [?] |
| Profile-guided | `make profile` (PGO build) |

## Build Artefacts

| Artefact | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `git` | Main binary dispatcher |
| `git-*` | Individual command binaries (symlinked or separate) |
| `libgit.a` | Static library (used internally) |
| `libgit-rs` | Rust bindings library (optional, `make libgit-rs`) |
| `*.mo` | Gettext message object files (localisation) |

## CI/CD

GitHub Actions handles all CI:

| Workflow | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `main.yml` | Multi-platform build + full test matrix (Linux, macOS, Windows [?]) |
| `check-style.yml` | Code style enforcement via clang-format |
| `check-whitespace.yml` | Whitespace / line-ending hygiene |
| `coverity.yml` | Static analysis (Coverity Scan — scheduled) [?] |
| `l10n.yml` | Localisation file validation |

The `main.yml` workflow uses a `ci-config` branch for per-repository CI
enablement and skip-if-redundant deduplication of identical commit trees.

## Installation

```sh
make install              # installs to $(prefix) (default: /usr/local)
make install prefix=/usr  # common system install
```

Package managers (`apt`, `brew`, `dnf`, `pacman`, etc.) build from a release
tarball and install into system paths.

## Release Process

1. Tag a version (`v2.54.0` format) in the repository
2. `GIT-VERSION-GEN` extracts the tag to produce `GIT-VERSION-FILE`
3. Release tarball created with `make dist` [?]
4. Signed and published to the Git project website and mirrored to GitHub

## Infrastructure Targets

| Target | Notes |
|--------|-------|
| Linux (x86-64, ARM) | Primary development and CI platform |
| macOS | Supported; Homebrew formula maintained separately |
| Windows | Supported via Git for Windows (separate repo/build); CI tests [?] |
| BSDs | Supported via portability shims in `compat/` |

## No Container / Cloud Deployment

This repository does not produce a container image or deploy to a cloud
service. Containerised Git is handled by downstream packaging.
